about.title: About
content: I'm an artistic director, event producer, and content creator from Acadia, New Brunswick. For over two decades I've worked across music, interactive media, documentary, and live events — always as the person who holds the creative vision and gets it made.

I live a bicultural life, not just bilingual. As an Acadian creator, I contribute equally to English and French worlds, sometimes writing in Chiac — the beautiful hybrid tongue where Shakespeare and Molière collide. My work reflects that: produced for NFB, Radio-Canada, CBC, and cultural institutions across Atlantic Canada.

I define success by how much I'm learning, how much I'm creating, and how curious life keeps me. Lately that curiosity has turned toward AI — I build tools that didn't exist six months ago, and I use them to make the work more interesting, not less human.

items.title: Carmen
items.description: An AI lyric-writing studio that learns your voice and helps you write songs that sound like you. Structured around verses, choruses, and bridges, with line-level tools for rhythm matching, rhyme finding, rewriting, and flow analysis. Works in English and French.

items.title: L'Estompe
items.description: A painting surface that keeps moving after you lift the pen. Marks feed a live fluid simulation, the currents grow into shapes, and a reaction-diffusion layer lets the image keep developing on its own. Built for iPad and Apple Pencil, with nine palettes and a Metamorphose pass that redraws the whole canvas.

items.title: La Réplique
items.description: A playwriting studio for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. A clean page for the text, a card board for the structure, and a pocket dramaturge that asks the questions a first draft needs. Bilingual throughout — every line in its own language and its echo, side by side — and each play publishes to a shareable web reading.

items.title: Amorce
items.description: A daily 25-minute pomodoro poetry studio. Each morning the app reads yesterday's journal entry, extracts a single noun and sensory image as kindling, and hands you the writing surface with a timer. When the chime falls, three AI images are drawn from your poem, and a Canvas tool lays the text over one — drag, resize, pick any of twelve typefaces — ready to share straight from the iOS share sheet. Cross-device sync via Firestore.

more.text: And a few hundred more — small tools built for one purpose, most of them in a weekend.

skills.title: Skills
skills.content: Three decades of making work that meets an audience — records, live productions, national television, museum installations, and interactive media. Fully bilingual across writing, direction, and production. Now designing and building software as well: web applications, native iOS and macOS apps, and audio instruments, developed solo with AI assistance.
